scope: Author-side regression evidence only; not an official fixed-case score or prepared answer.

benches.coverage: Every tr.* rule, clean baseline, statistical oracles, deterministic analysis, JSON/JSONL/CSV-style input handling and prospective screening guards.
Legacy shared section regression and false-positive guards.

semantic_checks: Aliases normalize to canonical topics without creating zero-count alias topics.
Generic years are not imputed as online, print or preprint years.
A zero previous-year baseline yields null growth, not zero or infinity.
A strong discontinuity is detectable; a flat series produces no supported turning point.
Low-citation method-first works can be selected over highly cited reviews.
No gap candidates produces an honest empty assessment rather than an invented gap.
github: GITHUB_URL.txt points to the public repository and this package directory.
